title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Cancellation and Resource Limit Verification
verification_method: Focused loopback tests, requirement-home trace tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene for DoQ cancellation, reset, internal-error, and dangling-stream limit behavior.
scope: This verification covers caller cancellation while awaiting a DoQ response, early client stream reset before FIN, opt-in dangling-stream connection closure, and unexpected handler failure mapping to `DOQ_INTERNAL_ERROR`. It does not verify client-side unsolicited RESET_STREAM volume limits, cancellation-volume closure, SERVFAIL resolver policy, padding, AXFR/IXFR, 0-RTT, address validation, or external interop.
preconditions: The DoQ foundation and minimal stream lifecycle slices exist.
The local managed QUIC loopback support is available for cancellation and reset tests.
expected_result: The focused DoQ stream lifecycle and RFC 9250 requirement-home tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9250 artifacts, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: The DoQ adapter now proves stream cancellation/reset behavior, internal-error abort mapping, and opt-in dangling-stream connection closure over real QUIC loopback. Remaining RFC 9250 cancellation-volume, unsolicited-reset, resolver-policy, privacy, transfer, 0-RTT, address-validation, and interop work remains future trace-owned scope.
